name: GNSS Train Positioning Error
description: Positioning error of the GNSS-based train location system. Checks whether accuracy is sufficient for ETCS level 3 operation.

elements.name: 95th Percentile Positioning Error
elements.description: Horizontal positioning error at 95th percentile including multipath and ionospheric effects.

uncertainty.source: GNSS measurement campaign on operational railway

elements.name: Maximum Allowable Position Error
elements.description: ETCS Level 3 maximum positioning error for safe train separation

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(err_gnss) = err_gnss if err_gnss <= err_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The ETCS L3 positioning error limit guards the GNSS error uncertainty set; errors above 5 m make safe train separation calculations unreliable.
